item.title: fix: keep verbose health available when channel probes stall (#128915)
item.summary: fix: keep verbose health available when channel probes stall (#128915) * fix(gateway): bound live health aggregation Keep verbose health within a Gateway-owned deadline, preserve healthy sibling results when channel probes stall, and document that the CLI timeout controls the Gateway connection. Fixes #128890 * fix(gateway): retain health probe permits Keep process-wide health capacity occupied until timed-out plugin work actually settles, and prove repeated refreshes cannot replace five stalled probes.
